title: Spiral Cinema Ruins
description: A woman in an orange jumpsuit stands on a crumbling spiral staircase inside a destroyed cinematic theater. Film strips line the stairs and walls while dramatic beams of golden light pierce through the broken dome ceiling surrounded by torn orange curtains.
